title: The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order

abstractEnglish: We prove that the two-color Ramsey number of the n-dimensional binary cube is at most $`C2^n`$, where C is an absolute constant. This resolves positively the hypercube Ramsey conjecture of Burr and Erdős.
